messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: jIbNyExhS476e9oAzrnZkQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "jIbNyExhS476e9oAzrnZkQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unfolds a map of the ruined royal city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept ridge at dusk overlooking a shattered skyline of broken spires; an ink-stained coat flaps as a brass compass spins above a parchment map.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of false paths ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A small oil lamp held aloft, its single flame-eye glowing amber, casting long warning shadows over the map's red-marked routes.

scenes.caption: The tin fox scouts the cracked outer wall.
scenes.visual_description: A clockwork fox with blue glass eyes crouches in rubble beside a collapsed gate, key-wind tail ticking softly under torn royal banners.

scenes.caption: The glass diver arrives through a shattered window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges headfirst from a tall broken pane, coat shimmering with reflections of distant fires.

scenes.caption: They pass under the great castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron-banded gates hang half-torn from hinges; four small figures slip beneath, dwarfed by carved stone lions.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp refuses the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower wreathed in violet mist; the lamp's eye narrows to a slit, light pulling backward away from the doorway.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a winged beast echo from the rooftops.
scenes.visual_description: Silhouettes of enormous claw-marks gouged across tile roofs, a single scaled feather drifting down past the tin fox's twitching ears.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector slumped at a checkpoint.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official snoring on a ledger pillow inside a tilted toll booth, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves and cheek.

scenes.caption: Mara bribes a stamp from his limp hand.
scenes.visual_description: Mara delicately lifts a wax seal from sleeping fingers while the lamp tilts to illuminate the official's drooling smile.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol marches along a torchlit avenue.
scenes.visual_description: From a low alley, the tin fox watches plated boots and pike-shadows pass between fallen banner poles, brass eyes glinting.

scenes.caption: The glass diver slips through a puddle into a mirrored hall.
scenes.visual_description: A coat-tail vanishing downward into a rain puddle, surfacing inside a long hall lined with cracked mirrors and tipped chandeliers.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a true name.
scenes.visual_description: An ornate door inscribed with rotating sigils glows pale green; the oracle lamp hovers close, flame-eye flickering as it whispers.

scenes.caption: The tin fox triggers the hidden latch.
scenes.visual_description: Small metal paws press a floor-tile rune; the door splits open in a spiral of light, illuminating four travelers at the threshold.

scenes.caption: They reach the captive in a sunken throne room.
scenes.visual_description: A figure curled inside a hanging glass cage above a cracked dais; the glass diver scales the cage from inside, hand pressed to the prisoner's.

scenes.caption: Alarm bells wake the tax collector mid-snore.
scenes.visual_description: Tower bells ring red over the city; the official jolts upright in his booth, papers fluttering, ledger sliding from his lap.

scenes.caption: The lamp lights a route through smoke.
scenes.visual_description: Thick black smoke curls through a courtyard of toppled statues; the lamp's flame-eye carves a narrow corridor of gold light forward.

scenes.caption: They sprint across the broken bridge at dawn.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge crumbling into a river of mist; four small figures run as planks fall away behind them, pink sunrise ahead.

scenes.caption: On the far shore, Mara marks the city as closed.
scenes.visual_description: A new map spread on a tree stump; a brass compass pins the corner while the tin fox curls asleep and the lamp dims to an ember.
